{{Quote|I teach being good, doing good, and asking good questions. That's about it, really.|Djinn Altis|<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
The '''Altisian Jedi''' were a splinter faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] headed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]]. They held several precepts frowned upon by the orthodox Jedi Order, including the taking of multiple apprentices by one master and allowing families.

==History==
Unlike the main Order, the Altisians were not all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]; there were many non-Jedi that lived within their community. Leaving the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the last decades of the Temple, Altis and his followers moved about [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] serving as relief workers on underdeveloped worlds and backwaters. The [[Jedi enclave (Bespin)|Jedi enclave]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] was used by Altis as training grounds.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of Altisians, including [[Callista Ming|Callista Masana]], [[Geith Eris]], and Altis himself were traveling aboard the ''[[Wookiee Gunner]]'' when they received a distress signal from the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] spy [[Hallena Devis]]. Rushing to her aide on [[JanFathal]], they met with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was unnerved by the unorthodox Jedi. After being rescued, Devis opted to join the Altisians instead of returning to the Republic.

Later in the war, the Altisians began working more closely with the High Council, taking on missions and helping win victories against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Jedi Masana would encounter Knight [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] at a rendezvous on [[Nerrif]] where Masana invited a distraught Tur-Mukan to join their group, one that would accept her and her child. Tur-Mukan agreed to think about it, planning on leaving at the end of the war.

Upon the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the Altisians went underground. In hiding, Master Altis established connections with fellow Masters [[Plett]] and [[Iri Camas]], setting up escape routes for survivors and other allies of the Jedi. Although Camas was killed early on in their operations, more and more Jedi were rescued. [[Force Adept]]s, [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]], and [[Daughters of the Ffib|Ffib nonconformists]] were helped into refuge. [[Bardan Jusik]], an ex-Jedi assisted in negotiating the transport of his former mentor, [[Arligan Zey]], and Master [[Kina Ha]] to the Altisian Jedi's headquarters.
